name: plantuml
description: PlantUML Diagrams — Nextcloud frontend (Viewer handler, file actions, the editor and the README observer)

scripts.build: ENTRY=editor vite --mode production build && ENTRY=files vite --mode production build && ENTRY=readme vite --mode production build
scripts.dev: ENTRY=files vite --mode development build && ENTRY=editor vite --mode development build && ENTRY=readme vite --mode development build

comment: Three IIFE bundles, one per surface: dist/plantuml-files.js (Viewer handler, file actions, + New), dist/plantuml-editor.js (CodeMirror split pane) and dist/plantuml-readme.js (the Text workspace observer). One vite config, selected by ENTRY, so each build stays the sibling apps' single-file IIFE shape.
